Definition: from G575 and G2808; to close fully:--shut up.
BiblicalUsage: Once, about a shut door. When the master of the house is risen up and hath shut to the door, those standing outside knock and say, Lord, Lord, open unto us — and He answers, I know you not whence ye are.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse, and the door is the whole sermon: it stands open now, and one day it will be shut.
